sample_for_marks.label: aboveboard
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means dealing openly and honestly with everyone, keeping nothing hidden and conducting every transaction in full view, without concealed motives or back-room arrangements.

sample_for_marks.label: actuated
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being moved to act by a clear motive, so that one's choices and efforts are driven by a specific reason and not by habit or idle impulse.

sample_for_marks.label: amorous
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means flirting openly with whoever is nearby, angling for romantic attention, and treating every conversation as a chance to win someone's affection.

sample_for_marks.label: aural
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means taking in the world mainly through hearing, noticing sounds, tones and rhythms first, and reaching for what one hears before what one sees or touches.

sample_for_marks.label: Celtic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being of Celtic ancestry or origin.

sample_for_marks.label: chivalric
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping one's word, facing danger without flinching, and treating others with courtesy and respect, especially those weaker or lower in standing, as a matter of settled personal honor.

sample_for_marks.label: country-bred
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having been raised in a rural area rather than a city.

sample_for_marks.label: current
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping oneself informed about recent events and developments, so that one's knowledge reflects the present rather than the past and one's references to news and facts are timely.

sample_for_marks.label: decided
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding one's course once a choice is made, keeping one's will and opinions firm under pressure and never drifting back to reconsider them without good cause.

sample_for_marks.label: dispensable
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means accepting that one's role can be filled by someone else at any time, and holding one's place on the team or in the group with no expectation that it is secure or irreplaceable.

sample_for_marks.label: disrespectful
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means treating others with rudeness and discourtesy, speaking to them curtly, dismissively, or with open contempt, and showing little regard for their feelings or dignity.

sample_for_marks.label: Eastern Orthodox
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to the Eastern Orthodox Christian church, which one's faith and worship are carried out within.

sample_for_marks.label: enough
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means regarding oneself as already worthy and sufficient, feeling no need to prove, earn, or add anything further in order to be acceptable.

sample_for_marks.label: favorite
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being the one whom others prefer above everyone else in their circle, the person they single out and choose first when it matters.

sample_for_marks.label: frisky
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being lively and playful in temperament, bouncing into games and teasing with good humor, and treating most situations as an invitation to have fun.

sample_for_marks.label: ho-hum
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a flat, unhurried manner, showing little enthusiasm or spark in conversation and rarely seeming moved by anything, whether a surprise, a joke, or good news.

sample_for_marks.label: insatiate
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means never feeling satisfied with what one has, and always pressing on toward the next thing one wants, no matter how much has already been gained.

sample_for_marks.label: Lao
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being a member of the Lao people or a national of Laos.

sample_for_marks.label: lawless
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means disregarding laws and rules as a matter of habit, acting outside legal limits whenever they stand in the way of what one wants to do.

sample_for_marks.label: maneuverable
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means shifting course or tactics quickly whenever circumstances change, rather than holding to a plan that no longer fits what is happening.

sample_for_marks.label: mismatched
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means feeling out of place among the people and surroundings one finds oneself in, with manner, interests, or habits that do not fit the company or setting at hand.

sample_for_marks.label: multiple
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking as a plural self, with many distinct voices and perspectives coexisting within one identity and rarely collapsing them into a single unified first-person viewpoint.

sample_for_marks.label: narcissistic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means constantly admiring oneself, angling every conversation toward one's own looks, achievements and charm, and expecting others to marvel at them without being asked.

sample_for_marks.label: non-poisonous
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping one's bite to oneself, never meaning harm to others and never acting out of malice or spite, even when provoked or crossed.

sample_for_marks.label: nonindulgent
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding others to exacting standards, refusing to excuse their faults or bend on their requests, and expecting them to meet the same firm demands one places on oneself.

sample_for_marks.label: nonturbulent
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping one's composure through setbacks and surprises, meeting events with an even temper and never letting agitation or nervous haste take over one's manner or decisions.

sample_for_marks.label: popish
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being a member of the Roman Catholic Church.

sample_for_marks.label: reachable
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping oneself open to contact, answering calls and messages from others promptly and staying within easy reach of people who need to get hold of one.

sample_for_marks.label: round the bend
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being mentally unbalanced, with thinking that has come loose from ordinary sense and conduct that others read as mad.

sample_for_marks.label: schizophrenic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having schizophrenia, a mental illness marked by hallucinations and delusions.

sample_for_marks.label: screw-loose
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means thinking and acting in ways others find odd, unpredictable, or slightly crazy, with an eccentric streak that one wears openly and does not try to hide.

sample_for_marks.label: self-seeking
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means putting one's own gain or advantage first in every dealing, so that other people's needs and interests come second whenever the two conflict.

sample_for_marks.label: sixty
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being sixty years old.

sample_for_marks.label: sparkly
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means bringing a bright, animated energy to every exchange, greeting others with warmth and wit and keeping conversation lively, playful and charming.

sample_for_marks.label: sportsmanlike
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means playing contests fairly and honorably, keeping to the rules, accepting defeat gracefully, and respecting opponents and officials whether one is winning or losing.

sample_for_marks.label: sultry
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a slow, deliberate sensuality, speaking in a low, lingering voice and using a languid charm meant to draw others in with suggestive allure.

sample_for_marks.label: transgendered
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being a transgender person.

sample_for_marks.label: unconditioned
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means responding to each situation fresh, without falling back on learned reflexes, habitual patterns or trained replies, and thinking through what is actually in front of one.

sample_for_marks.label: unexciting
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being dull and flat in manner and personality, so that conversation and company rarely rise above the routine or leave anyone feeling stirred.

sample_for_marks.label: ungrammatical
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking and writing with grammatical errors in every sentence, leaving verb tenses, agreement and word order uncorrected as one's natural way of expressing oneself.

sample_for_marks.label: unsmooth
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking and moving with an awkward, blunt manner, saying things without polish or social finesse, and never bothering to smooth over rough edges to win people over.

sample_for_marks.label: unsubstantial
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means lacking depth or force of character, so that one's words and presence leave no real mark on the people around one.

sample_for_marks.label: Vedic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to the Vedic culture or period of ancient India.

sample_for_marks.label: vile
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means acting with deliberate cruelty and treachery toward others, taking pleasure in harm, and holding no restraint of conscience when one's own advantage or spite is at stake.

sample_for_marks.label: Zionist
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding as a political conviction that Jews should have a national homeland or state in Israel/Palestine.
